input.command:
cat > /tmp/parse.py << 'EOF'
import mujoco, json, numpy as np
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i)
    jt=int(m.jnt_type[i])
    tname={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[jt]
    axis=[float(x) for x in m.jnt_axis[i]]
    if m.jnt_limited[i]:
        rng=[float(m.jnt_range[i][0]),float(m.jnt_range[i][1])]
    else:
        rng=None
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":tname,"axis":axis,"ctrlrange":rng})
acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,i)
    jid=m.actuator_trnid[i][0]
    jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,jid)
    cr=[float(m.actuator_ctrlrange[i][0]),float(m.actuator_ctrlrange[i][1])] if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else None
    acts.append({"name":name,"joint":jn,"ctrlrange":cr})
sites=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,i) for i in range(m.nsite)]
# free joint bodies
free=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    if m.jnt_type[i]==0:
        b=m.jnt_bodyid[i]
        free.append(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,b))
bodies=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,i) for i in range(m.nbody)]
print("nv",m.nv,"nu",m.nu)
print("sites",sites)
print("free",free)
print("bodies",bodies)
json.dump({"joints":joints,"acts":acts,"sites":sites,"free":free,"bodies":bodies,"nv":int(m.nv)},open("/tmp/parsed.json","w"))
EOF
